name: llmPlugin
description: Configure provider keys, default models, and global LLM defaults for every agent and llm() call in the context.

name: embeddingPlugin
description: Wire an embedding provider for the embedding() destination and downstream clustering with cosine().

name: mcpPlugin
description: Expose mcp() capabilities over Model Context Protocol, with JWT, OAuth 2.1, and bearer-token verification built in.

name: agentPlugin
description: Register named agents, the tools they can call, and shared defaults like system prompt and principal context.

name: httpPlugin
description: Expose routes over HTTP via the http() source, mounted as the catch-all surface on a named server; JWT, JWKS, or API-key auth at the plugin boundary.

name: serversPlugin
description: Declare the HTTP listeners the app binds, by name. HTTP, MCP, and custom plugins mount paths on a shared listener; a surface gets a dedicated port by declaring another named server.
